WRONG_RESPONSE_CLASS.reasoning: Cross-referencing each rejected candidate's concept against the key study unit's own learner decision (Phase 6 spot review) shows most of these 42 are genuinely off-topic: the structural-sibling discovery mechanism enumerates every TN chapter neighbor regardless of clinical relationship to the specific key (e.g. celiac disease's siblings are an unrelated acute-infant-vomiting cluster; esophageal perforation's siblings are an unrelated pulmonary-nodule/lung-cancer cluster). Of a 4-candidate spot sample from this bucket, 2 were correctly dead and 2 (Choledocholithiasis vs. acute cholecystitis; Consent and Capacity vs. negligence) looked clinically plausible on inspection and may have been mislabeled without adequate scrutiny -- a real, if secondary, concern, but not large enough in this sample to change which mechanism dominates.

MISSING_EVIDENCE_BINDING.reasoning: All 8 of these candidates (PSY-01 x5, PHELO-03 x3) are, per Phase 6 spot review, response-class- and granularity-matched to their key decision -- 5/6 sampled were CLINICALLY_PLAUSIBLE_FOR_SEMANTIC_AUTHORING or flagged only for a scoping caution (POTENTIAL_SECOND_KEY), not dead. The real, committed filter_candidates() contract does not authorize this rejection reason at the cheap-filter stage at all -- it belongs, if anywhere, to the post-authoring admit_relation()/_enforce_anchor_sufficiency() gate. This is exactly the conflation the anti-hallucination contract calls out: a candidate was refused for lacking the evidence binding that semantic authoring exists to build.

rows.reasoning: Classic DSM differential for schizoaffective disorder: distinguished from the key precisely by the substantial-mood-symptom-duration criterion the key decision names. Same response class (psychotic-spectrum DIAGNOSIS) and granularity as the key. No second-key risk: the key's discriminating criterion (>=2 weeks psychosis without prominent mood symptoms plus mood present a substantial portion of the illness) is exactly what would need to be shown ABSENT in this candidate.

Duration-based differential (1-6 months, no required mood component) in the same psychotic-spectrum family. Same response class/granularity as key; discriminator would be duration + absence of the qualifying mood pattern.

Duration <1 month differential, same family and response class. Genuinely plausible pre-authoring; evidence/anchor still needs targeted verification, but that is exactly what semantic authoring is for.
Distinguished from the key by the general absence of prominent hallucinations/disorganization and of the key's required mood pattern. Same response class; a real, teachable contrast.

rows.reasoning: This is a survey/overview study unit (an 'approach to' heading), not itself a discrete competing diagnosis entity. It is unclear the candidate resolves to a single, nameable option-set member at all; further canonicalization is needed before any relation could be authored -- correctly held back, though not for evidence-binding reasons and not because the response class is wrong.

A textbook management-decision contrast to acute cholecystitis: common bile duct stone changes management (ERCP indicated) versus straightforward early laparoscopic cholecystectomy. Same response class (management-strategy selection) as the key decision; the WRONG_RESPONSE_CLASS label applied to this one looks incorrect on inspection.

A classic paired legal-doctrine distractor for a negligence-elements MCQ (informed-consent/battery claims are commonly confused with negligence claims by learners). Plausibly same response class (legal-doctrine identification); the WRONG_RESPONSE_CLASS label looks premature without a closer look at the option-set archetype.

Presents in early infancy (2-8 weeks) with projectile vomiting; the key decision concerns testing for celiac disease in a child >=2 years old on a gluten-containing diet. Different age group, different presentation, different response class (a diagnosis entity offered against a diagnostic-test-choice decision). Correct rejection.

Evidence-synthesis designs do not themselves control confounding at the primary-study design stage; they are not a comparable answer option to 'random allocation' for the key decision's specific granularity (design-stage confounding control). On-topic study-design family, but not a live competitor for this exact decision.
A methodology-paradigm distinction, not a design feature that controls confounding. Same objection as the meta-analysis/SR candidate: on-topic family, wrong granularity for this specific decision.

Observational designs can themselves partially address confounding through matching/restriction/stratification, so an insufficiently scoped stem risks a second defensible answer. Same response class as the key, but needs a carefully scoped discriminator during relation authoring, not an outright rejection.

PID is evaluated primarily through pelvic tenderness/systemic findings, not through the vaginal pH/microscopy discrimination the key decision specifically calls for among BV/candidiasis/trichomoniasis. Topically adjacent (pelvic infection) but belongs to a different, if related, learner decision, not this one's response class.

phase6_semantic_spot_audit.note: Purpose was solely to test whether cheap filters discard clinically promising raw material, not to approve any seed. No relation, anchor, or seed was approved in this phase.

quantitative_support.discovery_precision_too_low: 8/10 opportunities with candidates produced 100% RESPONSE_CLASS_MISMATCH rejections (42/50, 84% of all rejections); the sole discovery mechanism that ever fired (CANONICAL_TN_STRUCTURAL_SIBLING, 50/50 candidates) is chapter-adjacency enumeration with no targeting to the key decision's own response class, and the four decision-aware discovery sources ahead of it in discovery_order all returned zero.
quantitative_support.evidence_binding_too_early: 2/10 opportunities (PSY-01, PHELO-03), 8/50 (16%) of rejections, used a rejection reason (MISSING_EVIDENCE_BINDING) the real filter_candidates() contract does not authorize; Phase 6 spot review found 5/6 sampled candidates in this bucket clinically plausible.

phase7_root_cause_decision.hypothesis_disposition: H18's own tentative label EXCESSIVE_PER_OPPORTUNITY_AUTHORING is NOT SUPPORTED as the dominant cause: the real per-candidate authoring cost was never reached for 42/50 candidates (they died at the discovery/cheap-filter boundary before any authoring was attempted), and for the 8/50 that were response-class-matched, they were rejected before authoring could even begin, not because authoring itself proved too expensive.

phase8_hypothesis_test.red_confirmed: ImportError before the fix (function did not exist); all 4 pass green after Phase 9's minimal repair.

phase9_minimal_safe_repair.change_summary: Added AUTHORIZED_PRE_SEMANTIC_REJECTION_REASONS and PREMATURE_AUTHORING_REJECTION_REASONS constants plus reclassify_premature_authoring_rejections(), a pure function that classifies a cheap-filter rejection ledger (in the shape any bounded-discovery funnel report or filter_candidates() output uses) into legitimate-vs-premature, failing closed on any unrecognized reason. filter_candidates() itself was NOT modified -- it already only emits the two legitimate reasons. This does not touch admit_relation(), validate_acquired_relation(), or _enforce_anchor_sufficiency(), which remain the sole places evidence/anchor/relation sufficiency is enforced, and only after independent review and verification.
phase9_minimal_safe_repair.scope_discipline: No redesign of Profile V2, feature snapshots, lifecycle architecture, difficulty, blueprints, option realization, final review, GraphRAG, or embeddings.

properties_verified: RESPONSE_CLASS_MISMATCH and GRANULARITY_MISMATCH still classify as legitimate (test_a_wrong_response_class_or_granularity_rejection_survives_reclassification)
filter_candidates() itself is byte-for-byte unmodified (git diff shows only additions after its return statement)
reclassify_premature_authoring_rejections() only ever returns candidate ids into two ledgers; it creates no seed, relation, or anchor and calls no admission function
admit_relation() still requires review.verdict == 'APPROVED' and verification_status == 'EVIDENCE_VERIFIED' (unchanged)
an unrecognized rejection reason fails closed (raises ContrastSupplyError) rather than silently defaulting to legitimate or premature

phase10_safety_preservation.does_not_widen_entry_into: APPROVED SEEDS -- no seed, relation, or anchor was approved by this repair

phase11_h18_raw_candidates_now_reaching_.explicit_non_claim: This is a candidate-funnel replay under the repaired contract, NOT a new H18 holdout acceptance/safe-yield rate. H18's original metrics (0/18 final_contrast_ready, etc.) stand unmodified.

phase12_development_12.selection_rule: From the 48-row DECISION_EVIDENCE_READY + FEATURE_READY pool built by the generalized pre-holdout readiness milestone (research/qgen/readiness/development_feature_maps_v6.json, already excludes historical pilots, fresh_holdout_18/24, and onboarding-pilot units per research/qgen/readiness/development_exclusion_inventory.json), sort each discipline's rows by their development_id string and take the first 2.

phase13_existing_seed_baseline.method: Deterministic set-membership check: every anchor_study_unit_id / retrieval_scope.study_unit_ids across all 4 existing curated/development seed packs (r4, g2_extensions, g2_targeted, v6_development_seed_pack) intersected against the development-12 study unit ids. Retrieval requires an exact anchor_study_unit_id match, so a unit absent from every pack's scope cannot retrieve regardless of feature/profile realization.

phases_14_to_24_not_attempted.reason: Bounded candidate discovery, semantic relation authoring, targeted evidence verification, independent seed/anchor review, development seed-pack construction, retrieval replay, and conditional item generation/blind-solve/final-review each require the same per-opportunity clinical-authoring depth that, per MEMORY.md, took full prior sessions to complete for comparable or smaller slices (e.g. the Route-B/C waves attempted 8-24 opportunities per full session; the AOM development control alone took a full seed-pack-onboarding milestone). Compressing 12 fresh opportunities through discovery, clinical relation authoring, independent review, item generation, blind solve, and final medical review within this session's effort budget would mean giving each step far less scrutiny than the anti-hallucination contract and Phase 18/23/24 independent-review requirements demand. Reporting PARTIAL and stopping here is preferred over fabricating plausible-looking but insufficiently-reviewed clinical content for a real question bank.
